# Thomas Online

> A family-owned New Zealand online toy, book, and party supply store based in Whangarei, offering gifts, crafts, and licensed character products for kids with community fundraising support.

Thomas Online serves NZ families with a curated selection of toys, arts and crafts, party supplies, and gifts. The store features new arrivals, sales, corporate gifting solutions, and a fundraising program where schools and clubs earn 10% from customer orders.
